suite: r1067 exact Arabic Yasin timing and source identity

checks.name: Actual original MP3 hash and byte length agree with acquisition metadata, documented cues and compiled runtime
Canonical 83-verse source is unchanged and bound by its actual source hash
Production map preserves all 83 measured start/end boundaries exactly
Intro remains verse zero until measured Yasin onset; seven seconds is verse one
Every measured onset switches by exact floor semantics immediately before, at and after its boundary
Every full verse interval, including interverse silence, holds its preceding verse
4096 reproducible random media timestamps agree with an independent linear oracle
Missing, nonfinite, wrongly typed and negative media times fail closed
Only the exact immutable source hash and byte count permit timing
Duration identity permits bounded native rounding and rejects wrong or unknown recordings
Runtime API, snapshot, intro, review and every returned cue are deeply protected against mutation
Source position is independent of playback rate, elapsed wall time and external clock values
Machine audit and 20 ms resolution are accurately described without human or probability claims
